prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. GLAZE FRINGE GROVE. A tangible invented NATURE ecosystem revealed by fictional STRUCTURED-LIGHT SINUSOIDAL FRINGE PROJECTION PROFILOMETRY. Medium: clean optical laboratory exposure of neutral matte grey ORGANIC FORMS illuminated by ONE common projector casting about18 broad parallel BLACK-GREY-WHITE SINUSOIDAL LIGHT BANDS across each complete subject. The bands are an illumination signal: projected bright-white peaks, charcoal troughs and smooth grey transitions bend/compress/shift across leaf folds, bellies and curved wings as a measured-depth pattern. A common mostly vertical projector direction continues consistently across the form, displaced by its contours. There is no coloured body surface, glossy shine, metallic reflection or material grain. Soft neutral volume is present only to describe the tangible organism; high-contrast deformed light fringes are the unmistakable dominant visual language, legible at small size. Think a precise optical3D-scanning exposure, not a normal nature painting. The projected bands must NEVER be physical ribs, carved grooves, stacked sheets, concentric rings, bark texture, feathers, real zebra stripes, ink hatching, engraving, a print pattern, wireframe, rainbow interference, coloured registration, fluorescent fibres, heat map, speckled dots or X-ray anatomy. No luminous corona, fog, particles or surrounding beam. Complete natural structure has believable connections and strong silhouette, with open spaces through curled leaves/wings. Fictional artistic scan, not an actual measured experiment. No text, labels, scale bars, coordinates, numerals, clock faces, readings, graphs, logos or watermark.
